scope: Current selected gameplay input source observation only; not runtime acceptance
live_ref_check: Fresh GitHub branch GET by /root/map_screen_design confirmed this head during the latest control-correction audit.

observations.finding: First eligible unclaimed touch records its actual position as movement origin; no fixed joystick-zone or left-side eligibility check. Drag determines heading.
Visible resting hint uses the lower-left safe rect. Active joystick centers on world.touch_origin; knob follows drag. The visual uses MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE.

Vehicle, camp dock, camp layout and settlement handlers precede inherited movement. Inherited HUD controls reserve particular fingers. This is per-control routing, not proof of complete multi-pointer ownership.
Second world touch starts pinch and clears movement; remaining pinch finger cannot become movement until all world fingers lift. Joystick hides during pinch.

Release/cancel clears movement. Resize clears movement/camera/inherited HUD state. Focus-loss/application-pause path additionally releases settlement and held vehicle input. Broader dock/layout/modal ownership still needs explicit acceptance.
Project main scene selects field_opening.tscn and its field_opening.gd script. Existing touch-resume/run-input test definitions were read, not executed.

acceptance_gaps.finding: The active 50-unit-radius joystick visual has no edge clamp and may extend outside visible/safe bounds near an edge.
acceptance_gaps.required_followup: UI02: demonstrate all-edge/corner touch origins with feedback inside actual safe bounds while preserving the logical origin/direction/speed.

acceptance_gaps.finding: Camp dock stores one finger; another pointer may fall through while that slot is occupied.
acceptance_gaps.required_followup: UI02/UI03: mixed world/dock/map multitouch must not leak movement or trigger unintended actions.

acceptance_gaps.finding: Quality control reserves its pointer but runs its action only with no world fingers; do not claim all UI controls are currently actionable during movement.
acceptance_gaps.required_followup: Bind and test intended concurrent-action policy; preserve ownership even when an action is deliberately unavailable.

acceptance_gaps.finding: A press outside an open camp sheet dismisses it and returns false; that sheet is not a full-screen input barrier.
acceptance_gaps.required_followup: Expanded map and blocking modals need explicit pointer and pause policies, tested against world movement and purchases.

acceptance_gaps.finding: Reset paths do not by source observation alone certify every held dock/layout/modal pointer or device transition.
acceptance_gaps.required_followup: Record actual rotation/fold/resize, release/cancel, focus-loss and resume tests on the implemented candidate.
